newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks ease in dull trade amid strike.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks ease in dull trade amid strike.

text.p: Pakistani stocks eased on Thursday in dull trading owing to an opposition-called general strike that paralysed the industrial port city of Karachi, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share price index closed 1.94 points, or 0.14 percent, lower at 1,382.57 amid six losers and one gainer. Volume dipped to 0.7 million shares from Wednesday's 26 million because of thin attendance, one dealer said.
Trading took place in only eight scrips out of 791 companies listed on the KSE.
ICI Pakistan fell 0.20 to 16.10 rupees, Fauji Fertilizer 0.35 to 69.35, FFC Jordan 0.10 to 12.90 and PTCL 0.10 to 33.05.
Dewan Salman rose 0.10 to 22.20 and HUBCO closed unchanged at 31.50.
